\subsection*{Source-weighted capacity candidate audit}
The bundle directory \texttt{g2\_capacity\_candidate} contains the
candidate register, the complete formula-level novelty comparison and
the adversarial review of Proposition~\ref{prop:v129-capacity}. The
finite projected-source values quoted after that proposition were
recomputed from the archived $\lambda=3$, $N=64$ interval midpoints
only as a falsification diagnostic. They are not interval certificates
and are not used in the proof of the Picone identity.

The review independently expands the archimedean constant, checks both
prime orientation factors, preserves the zero-extension killing terms
and verifies the first-slot-linear pole sign. It also records the
two-coordinate counterexample to the tempting claim that
$W_\lambda h\ge0$ pointwise alone proves positivity. The only rigorous
new implication is therefore the conditional capacity reduction.
The arithmetic capacity estimate, its cofinal error and the odd sector
remain open.
